families.name: STRICT_TOLERANT
families.coverage: Strict binary interpretation and text parsing throw their declared substrate failures; Try variants return null and partial variants retain their declared prefixes.

families.name: ROW_RETENTION
families.coverage: CROSS drops failed interpretation rows while OUTER APPLY preserves the null-extended row, including empty and validation cases.

families.name: FAILURE_BOUNDARY
families.coverage: Schema binding, provider open/read, cancellation and engine-invariant failures remain distinct from substrate interpretation errors.

families.name: PARTIAL_METADATA
families.coverage: Partial field dictionaries, failure fields, diagnostic codes, positions, consumed units, nested paths and encodings remain truthful.

contract.verificationResult: 48/48 cases verified before observation and again before completion; the frozen contract records strict, tolerant, partial, row-retention, failure-boundary and metadata expectations.

initialObservations.finding: The first observation exposed fixture helper assumptions, byte-versus-int assertion mismatches, and schema-boundary oracle calibration; it was retained as pre-final-calibration evidence.
After helper and type corrections, the remaining failures were the direct schema-definition boundary expectations; no production source was changed.
The calibrated permanent matrix passed before adjacency and full-gate qualification.

repairAttempts.note: These correction attempts did not emit a behavioral TRX and are not counted as passing or failing test cases. Their purpose was to correct namespace, exception-type and direct-schema helper compilation before the r8 observation.

focusedReplay.coverage: The final permanent matrix exercises all 48 frozen identifiers across strict/tolerant/partial interpretation, CROSS versus OUTER row retention, unrelated failure boundaries and partial metadata.

adjoiningSuites.name: stale-filter-correction
adjoiningSuites.note: The filter matched no test case; this artifact is preserved and excluded from the passing adjacency total.

initialAdjacentObservations.name: stale-filter-zero-test-selection
initialAdjacentObservations.finding: The class filter selected no tests; the exact class name was located and rerun in REC-131-adj-rec129-r2.

obligations.REC-131-O01: The permanent 48-case matrix compares strict Parse/Interpret, Try variants and Partial variants over malformed rows between valid rows, with binary and text units represented.
obligations.REC-131-O02: The row-retention family asserts that CROSS drops null results and OUTER APPLY preserves null-extended rows for valid, malformed, empty and validation inputs.
obligations.REC-131-O03: The failure-boundary family keeps schema compilation, provider failures, cancellation and BasicEntity engine invariants distinct from ordinary substrate mismatch; Try helpers do not catch unrelated exceptions.
obligations.REC-131-O04: The partial-metadata family asserts field dictionaries, failure fields, ISE codes, positions, consumed bytes/chars, nested paths and encoding facts on success and failure.
obligations.acceptance: No automatic correction changed strictness or row-retention policy; no production repair was required.

notes: The initial r2, r3, r5, r6 and r7 correction attempts were compile-only and emitted no behavioral TRX; they are not represented as passing or failing test counts.

The direct schema-definition cases intentionally preserve the frozen MQ4003/MQ4004 boundary. A query-level undefined-reference probe produced MQ2030 and was not substituted for the frozen direct-definition oracle.

The final focused matrix and all corrected adjacencies ran before the authoritative full gate. The full gate includes the three established generated-code refresh skips from REC-085-skip-allowlist.json.
No production source or behavior was changed for REC-131; the scope records a clean qualification of the existing strict, tolerant, partial and unrelated-failure boundaries.
